text:
Aisha: Evening triage — quick pulse before handoff. Queue: 46 open tickets (8 P1, 12 P2, rest P3). Incoming rate spiked ~18/hr last 2h. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Luca: Noted. Any repeaters?
Aisha: Yes — 9 tickets reference "embedding failed" and 6 are billing duplicates. Top user-impacting: embed generation 500s for batch jobs since ~22:10 UTC. We're routing to fallback model but some customers see degraded quality.
Tom: ops-bot posted alert: "embedding-service 502 spike" at 22:12 UTC — we restarted worker pool but errors persisted.
Priya: I'm on embed failures. Root cause looks like a token bucket limit on the new quantized encoder. Can reproduce locally with the test harness.
Aisha: Blockers: need macro updates for customer-facing messaging + can someone patch the rollback route to route to v1-embed when errors >5/min?
Luca: I'll do the rollback route change. Pinging @eng-runtime for a quick review of the routing config. Also can we add a temporary macro "embed-retry-ack"?
Tom: Draft macro below — please sanity-check:
```text
Hi — we're seeing intermittent embedding failures. We've routed your job to a fallback encoder and it should complete shortly. If you see a duplicate charge, reply with "billing-dup" and we'll escalate.
```
Priya: Suggest tweak: include ETA ~5-10min and link to status page. Also add internal macro "embed-ops-note" for the ticket owner with steps we ran.
Luca: I'll add both. Internal macro:
```text
embed-ops-note:
- Re-routed to v1-embed
- Cleared local worker queue
- Raised rate-limit ticket with infra
```
Aisha: For billing duplicates — use macro "billing-dup" that triggers refund workflow. Can someone confirm macros have the right placeholders for {customer_id}?
Tom: Confirmed placeholders present. Updated macros pushed to staging. Need one reviewer for prod deploy.
Priya: I'll review in 10m. Also heads-up: one customer on Dedicated reported slow logs retrieval — probably unrelated but flagging.
Aisha: Handoff: I'm off at 23:00 UTC, Luca taking next shift. Luca — can you own prod macro deploy and embed fallback route?
Luca: Yep. I'll deploy macros at 22:55 UTC after Priya signoff. Will also add alert suppression for noisy 502s so we don't drown nightly ops.
ops-bot: Scheduled reminder set for 22:55 UTC — "deploy-support-macros"
Tom: If anyone's doing postmortem starter, I'll draft a one-page with timelines and customer impact.
Aisha: Thanks team. :thumbsup: Please add any follow-ups here before handoff.
